sources.location: https://doi.org/10.1016/J.MATBIO.2023.12.001 (not retrieved; PRIDE record and deposited Sample_to_file_mapping.xlsx used)

claims.value: Genotype, biological/technical replicate and gel band per RAW from the deposited mapping table.
claims.evidence: Sample_to_file_mapping.xlsx lists every RAW with genotype, biological replicate, SDS-PAGE band/lane and technical replicate.

claims.value: Q Exactive HF DDA HCD; Trypsin/LysC; Mascot (PD 2.3) 5 ppm / 0.2 Da; Carbamidomethyl C fixed; Oxidation M/K/P, Galactosyl K, Glucosylgalactosyl K variable.
claims.evidence: PRIDE sample/data-processing protocol gives the instrument and the search settings separately for collagen I (MEF) and collagen IV (kidney) samples.

limitations: The in-gel digestion used a Trypsin/Lys-C mix; recorded as Trypsin (reconciler flags it).
Reconciler 'organism_part_from_cultured_material' is a false positive from the shared record (MEF part); this file is mouse kidney tissue.
Galactosyl (UNIMOD:907) / Glucosylgalactosyl (UNIMOD:393) map the Mascot 'galactosyl(K)' and 'glukosylgalactosyl(K)' names; the exact Unimod entries were matched by name only.
Age, sex and strain of mice not stated in the deposit: not available.
